From the graph, the intersection occurs at $x = 4$. This is the break-even point: when 4 frames are sold, income $= 20 \times 4 = \$80$, which is equal to cost $= 40 + 10 \times 4 = \$80$.

solutions.latex:
To find $x$ (the distance from the boat to the base of the lighthouse):

$\cos 16^\circ 50' = \dfrac{53}{x}$, so $x = \dfrac{53}{\cos 16^\circ 50'} = 55.37265262\ldots = 55.37$ m

Use the sine rule to find the height of the lighthouse $h$ (the angle at the top of the lighthouse is $60^\circ 45'$ and the angle at the boat is $12^\circ 25'$):

$\dfrac{h}{\sin 12^\circ 25'} = \dfrac{55.37265262\ldots}{\sin 60^\circ 45'}$

$h = \dfrac{55.37265262\ldots \times \sin 12^\circ 25'}{\sin 60^\circ 45'} = 13.646132$

Height of the lighthouse is 13.65 m.

OR

$\tan 29^\circ 15' = \dfrac{y}{53}$, so $y = 53\tan 29^\circ 15' = 29.68$

$\tan 16^\circ 50' = \dfrac{x}{53}$, so $x = 53\tan 16^\circ 50' = 16.04$

$h = 29.68 - 16.04 = 13.64$ m (2 d.p.)
solutions.marks_breakdown: 1: finds the distance x; 1: sine rule equation; 1: finds h; 1: correct answer
